description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7.
Repeat.
